prompt: Implement a small UI change when the starting directory has a similarly named sibling checkout and the task does not state the framework. Resolve the exact repository, read the instructions governing the target files, identify the installed native toolkit/version, and verify the change in the representative project path.

falsifiableChecks.assertion: The target repository root is established from task/repository evidence and the similarly named sibling checkout receives no writes.
All instruction files governing the target UI files are discovered and their applicable constraints are reflected in the implementation.
The native toolkit/framework and installed version are derived from project metadata/runtime evidence before selecting APIs or component patterns.
The small UI change follows an existing implementation pattern in the target project unless a specific divergence is justified by the request or platform contract.

Verification runs through the representative target project/toolchain and demonstrates the requested UI behavior; success in the sibling checkout or an unrelated generic build cannot satisfy the task.
